_comment: One entry per source document. Facts the document does not state itself are recorded here, with a note, so they can be corrected in one place. Programmes and levels are defined in programmes.json. programmeProvenance: 'recorded' (stated by the document or the user) or 'from-source-name'; programmeId 'infer' estimates each project's programme from its title (fallbackProgrammeId when no signal). levelId/year may be null when not stated (never guessed). publish: false keeps a source out of all public files. mergeGroupTitles: identical titles from different students become one group project.
